channel.title: Manglo Playbook
channel.description: Practical field guides for images, uploads, calculations and independent selling

item.title: How to compress product images without making them blurry
item.description: A practical image-export workflow for online sellers: choose sensible dimensions, compare detail, and make smaller files without hiding the product.

item.title: Calculate your real profit per order—not just your markup
item.description: Understand the real difference between selling price, markup, profit and margin with transparent INR and USD examples.

item.title: JPG vs PNG vs WebP: a seller’s practical image guide
item.description: Choose among JPG, PNG and WebP for product listings, transparent graphics, social images and web pages without relying on vague file-size claims.

item.title: Is your discount actually profitable? Work it out before the sale
item.description: Understand how percentage discounts affect net profit and contribution margin, with a worked INR example and a simple break-even method.

item.title: A simple phone photography setup for better product listings
item.description: Make clearer product photos using a window, clean background and repeatable angles before using free crop, resize and export tools.

item.title: The product listing preflight checklist: 12 things to check
item.description: A clear, printable 12-step quality checklist for images, titles, pricing, shipping promises, customer trust and final mobile preview.

item.title: How to compress an image to 100 KB or 200 KB for an online form
item.description: Step-by-step guide to reducing JPG, PNG or WebP images toward a 100 KB or 200 KB upload limit without sacrificing essential details.

item.title: How to resize a photo in pixels without stretching or blurring it
item.description: Learn the difference between pixel dimensions and file size, preserve aspect ratio, and resize photos for websites, profile images and forms.

item.title: How to convert PNG to JPG, JPG to PNG or WebP correctly
item.description: A practical conversion guide for JPG, PNG and WebP, including transparency, quality, web use and common upload mistakes.

item.title: Photo upload failed? Fix file size, format and dimension errors
item.description: Troubleshoot common photo and signature upload errors on application forms, portals and websites with a clear diagnostic checklist.

item.title: How to calculate a discount percentage and final price
item.description: Simple formulas for 10%, 20%, 30% and other discounts, with worked rupee examples and a check for real savings.

item.title: How to crop a photo to square, portrait or landscape
item.description: Understand 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 and 9:16 photo ratios and crop images without stretching or cutting off the subject.
